name: Plate L: Metatron's Cube
description: Thirteen circles of the Fruit of Life joined by seventy-eight lines, within which every Platonic solid lies hidden. Struck in Lapis Lazuli: ground lapis, the stone of the night sky and of Egyptian heaven. Degree of Adept, rank 128 of the folio. “OBSCVRVM PER OBSCVRIVS”: The obscure by the more obscure.
